about_the_game:
In Catastrophe - Earthquake, you control Phe, who, during a visit to her brother, becomes trapped in a condemned building. What was supposed to be a family gathering turns into a desperate fight for survival.

The building is in ruins, earthquakes are shaking everything around, and time is running out. Phe must escape before the collapses and other dangers bring her to a tragic end. Your mission is to find essential survival items such as water, food, and medication, which are scattered throughout the apartment.

But be careful! At any moment, the ceiling or floor might collapse, things could explode, and shards of glass might cause damage! This requires you to adapt quickly to survive. Each tremor brings new challenges and unexpected dangers.

The flashlight will be your best friend, but its battery is limited. Use it wisely to explore the ruined building and find the safest escape route.

An intense survival challenge

Prepare for an intense survival challenge! If you die, you'll have to start the game over, with your inventory reset and items redistributed to different locations in the apartment. Every mistake could be fatal, and survival will depend on your ability to adapt and learn from your errors.

An intense and thrilling experience

Catastrophe - Earthquake offers an intense and thrilling gaming experience, with realistic graphics, convincing physics, and a constant atmosphere of suspense. Feel the tension of the earthquakes, the adrenaline of the escape, and the satisfaction of overcoming challenges.

Join the fight for survival!

Join the fight for survival in Catastrophe - Earthquake and see if you can escape the collapsing building!

  • Realistic graphics and convincing physics

  • Constant atmosphere of suspense

  • Challenging and unpredictable gameplay

  • Permadeath mechanic with item respawn

  • Intuitive controls and user-friendly interface
